summary: Build practical TNA, competency mapping, and impact planning skills. Learn to prioritise training and report results with confidence.
lede: Workforce learning analysis helps HR and learning professionals identify capability gaps and decide which needs training can address. The course covers gathering survey, interview, performance-review and job-analysis data; mapping competencies and prioritising interventions; and setting pre- and post-training measures, behaviour indicators and impact reporting for management review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to diagnose capability gaps, prioritise learning investments, and present credible training impact plans.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: working knowledge of HR, L&D, or performance improvement processes; ability to interpret basic workforce data; and familiarity with training planning or evaluation cycles. No coding or programming is required. A laptop is recommended for survey analysis, worksheet completion, and dashboard exercises. Advanced concepts such as AI-supported skills taxonomies are covered at an operational awareness level, not as technical engineering.
